summary: The portal is rebuilt from the ground up as an installable app in Nora's own look, with a new front page, a live map, people's patterns, plans, games and Nora's own pages.
details: Today, the new front page: whether Nora is listening, who is around and where, who is playing, what is coming up, a line from her notes about you, and the circle.

The map shows everyone live in their own colour on a warm-grey map in both lightings; pick someone for their details and a route over the last hour to week. On a phone the list is a sheet you drag over the map.

Each person has a page: their last day on a map, plans you share, the games that know them, the places Nora has worked out for them, a usual week hour by hour with the current hour marked, and their routes grouped into regular ones.
Plans are grouped by week, and a plan can be added to your calendar, opened in a maps app or shared.
Games show who is on now; each server has players, activity, a leaderboard, busy hours, who plays together and its world; each player has their character, body, gear and playtime per day.
Nora's own pages: how she is, the reminders she holds (time and platform only), what she remembers about you (only you can see it), her doctrine as a reader, and every tool and skill she has.
It installs to a phone's home screen, works offline with what it last saw (and says so), and search (⌘K or /) finds any person, server, plan, doctrine section or tool.
Studio and late-night lighting and the language choice carry over from Nora's public page; Chinese dates read in Cantonese (聽日, 而家).
limitations: The portal only reads: plans are still made and answered in the group chat, and there is no chat with Nora on the web.

Old portal links (status, memory, doctrine, tools, events) redirect to where their content lives now; bookmarks keep working, but an app installed from the old portal should be reinstalled to pick up the new icon and name.
